{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Enterprise Texas Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Trinity River Basin, north of Arlington, Texas to Sherman Extension interconnect near Justin, Denton County, Texas.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/news/barnett-shippers-sign-up-for-capacity-on-enterprise-expansion/|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==

=== Trinity River Supply Lateral ===
*'''Owner: '''Enterprise Products Partners LP<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''1,000 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/news/barnett-shippers-sign-up-for-capacity-on-enterprise-expansion/|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''40 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/news/barnett-shippers-sign-up-for-capacity-on-enterprise-expansion/|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''30, 36 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/news/barnett-shippers-sign-up-for-capacity-on-enterprise-expansion/|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Proposal year: '''2007<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/news/barnett-shippers-sign-up-for-capacity-on-enterprise-expansion/|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Start year: '''2010<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
